_translationStatus: MACHINE-DRAFTED, NOT NATIVE-REVIEWED. Generated for SCRUM-205. The safety-critical strings — lightning.*, actions.*, guidance.*, wbgt.superseded, freshness.staleWarning — MUST be reviewed by a native Burmese speaker before this language is offered in production. A mistranslated stop-work instruction is an incident, not a typo.
_encoding: UNICODE ONLY. This file is Myanmar Unicode (U+1000–U+109F), not Zawgyi. Myanmar's national migration to Unicode completed in 2019 and Android 12+ ships Unicode Myanmar fonts. A device still running Zawgyi will render this as garbled text — that is a known, accepted limitation, and such a worker can switch language from the sign-in picker. Do NOT 'fix' garbled Burmese by transcoding this file to Zawgyi; see the README.
